aiApps.tgStep1Help:
How to get a Bot Token (BotFather):
1. Find @BotFather on Telegram (or open t.me/BotFather)
2. Press Start, then send /newbot
3. Choose a display name (e.g. "My CRM Secretary")
4. Choose a username — it must be unique and end with 'bot' (e.g. my_crm_bot)
5. BotFather replies with an API Token in this format: 123456789:ABCdefGHI... (numbers:letters)
6. Copy the whole Token and paste it below
⚠️ The Token is the key to your bot — don't share it. If it leaks, send /revoke to BotFather immediately.
aiApps.tgTokenBad: Invalid token — check for typos, or create a new bot via @BotFather
aiApps.tgStep2Help:
How to find your User ID:
Your User ID is a number (e.g. 123456789), NOT your username.
Method 1 (easiest):
1. Search @userinfobot on Telegram
2. Press Start — it instantly tells you your ID
Method 2:
1. Search @get_id_bot → Press Start — same result
Paste the number below once you have it.
aiApps.tgChatOk: ✅ Test message sent — check your Telegram
aiApps.tgChatBad: Send failed — User ID may be wrong. Note: you must message the bot first (press Start) before it can message you
